metadata.technology_specification: Triple quadrupole liquid chromatography-mass spectrometer (Triple Q LC-MS)
metadata.technology_reasoning: The triple quadrupole LC-MS is the industry-standard analytical instrument for quantitative mass spectrometry due to its high selectivity and sensitivity using three sequential quadrupole mass filters coupled with liquid chromatography to separate complex mixtures. It dominates market share in pharmaceutical, environmental, and biochemical analysis labs worldwide as of 2024.

components.reasoning: The LC system is an essential front-end module that separates analytes in complex mixtures before mass spectrometric detection; it is a standard, separately procured subsystem comprising pumps, autosamplers, and columns.
A critical module that converts liquid-phase analytes into gas-phase ions for MS analysis, ionization sources are standard and vary primarily between ESI and APCI types in LC-MS instruments.
The first quadrupole filters precursor ions by m/z ratio, fundamental to the triple quadrupole configuration and always a distinct component.
The collision cell performs fragmentation of selected precursor ions by collision-induced dissociation, a core functional element unique to triple quadrupole MS designs.
The second mass filter analyzes fragment ions, essential for selective detection of product ions, distinctive to triple quadrupole MS instruments.
A critical subsystem that maintains high vacuum conditions in the mass spectrometer region to enable free ion movement; typically includes turbomolecular and rotary pumps, always present.
The detector converts ion impacts into electronic signals and is a vital component for data acquisition, procured as a discrete unit.
Includes digital signal processing and instrument control electronics, a standard subsystem essential for operation and data management.
The physical chassis and user interface housing, while varying in design, is a standard structural component purchased as an assembly or manufactured separately from internal modules.

Liquid Chromatography (LC) System.name: Stainless steel
Liquid Chromatography (LC) System.reasoning: Widely used for the high-pressure tubing and fittings due to corrosion resistance and strength; industry standard in LC systems.

Liquid Chromatography (LC) System.name: Polyethylene terephthalate
Liquid Chromatography (LC) System.reasoning: Commonly used in flexible tubing and seals, providing chemical resistance and flexibility; alternatives exist but less common at high pressure.

Liquid Chromatography (LC) System.name: Glass
Liquid Chromatography (LC) System.reasoning: Used in solvent reservoirs and optical flow cells for transparency and chemical inertness; standard in LC systems though quartz may also be used.

Liquid Chromatography (LC) System.name: Acetonitrile
Liquid Chromatography (LC) System.reasoning: Primary solvent used in mobile phases for LC; essential for proper chromatographic separation; standards in LC chemistry.

First Quadrupole Mass Filter (Q1).name: Copper
First Quadrupole Mass Filter (Q1).reasoning: Used for electrical connections and wiring within the quadrupole assembly; common conductor though other metals possible.

First Quadrupole Mass Filter (Q1).name: Ceramic
First Quadrupole Mass Filter (Q1).reasoning: Insulating supports and spacers for quadrupole rods to maintain structure and electrical isolation; industry standard.

Collision Cell (Q2).name: Stainless steel

Collision Cell (Q2).name: Ceramic
Collision Cell (Q2).reasoning: Used as rod supports, insulators and collision gas container components for electrical insulation and durability.

Collision Cell (Q2).name: Argon
Collision Cell (Q2).reasoning: Inert collision gas introduced into the cell for controlled fragmentation; absolutely essential for collision-induced dissociation.

Second Quadrupole Mass Filter (Q3).name: Stainless steel

Second Quadrupole Mass Filter (Q3).name: Ceramic

Second Quadrupole Mass Filter (Q3).name: Copper

Vacuum System (Pumps and Chambers).name: Stainless steel

Vacuum System (Pumps and Chambers).name: Copper
Vacuum System (Pumps and Chambers).reasoning: Used in vacuum pump motors and electrical components for conductivity; standard but alternatives exist.

Vacuum System (Pumps and Chambers).name: Vacuum pump materials
